points.point: YouTube video failed to upload (why it failed)
points.sentence: The platform rejected the media Blotato tried to upload. It is not a rate-limit or credits problem, and retrying the same media without changes will not help.

points.point: What to do about the failed upload
points.sentence: Open the failed post in Posts > Failed (in the web app), or in Logs (if you use the API), to read its exact error. Then follow the matching steps in the Error Reference.

verdict.reason: The customer gives no error text or code, and this generic entry covers a failed video upload to any platform, including YouTube, and tells them how to find the exact error.
